description:
+[Added] Quick Delivery options (15 and 30 minutes)
+ [Added] Food Delivery module
+ [Improved] Category flow
+ [Added] Seller-level Attribute and Custom Field management
+ [Improved] Veg and Non-Veg moved to Custom Fields
+ [Added] Module-wise theme color management
+ [Added] WebP image support in the Admin Panel and Web App
+ [Added] Social media icon management for the Website from the Admin Panel
+ [Added] Seller warning for Global Attributes and Custom Fields before their removal in the next update
+ [Updated] App codebase upgraded to the latest Flutter version (3.47.2) (Customer App, Partner App)
+ [Improved] System performance and overall functionality
+ [Fixed] Minor bugs and other issues
